_comment: Rates used to turn measured token counts into an ESTIMATED cost. Ships as EXAMPLE
DEFAULTS, the same convention as docs/scope-and-stack.md - replace them with the rates
your organisation actually pays, then update rates_as_of. Every figure derived from this
file is marked inferred in every view that shows it, and no view ever presents it as a
bill. A model that is not listed here shows its tokens with a cost of 'unknown' rather
than being priced from a guess: a silently wrong currency figure is worse than a visibly
missing one, and new model IDs will keep appearing.
